Translation Quote

Get in touch for professional translation services

Get a Quote
Watch Our Video

BeTranslated is a boutique translation agency serving the translation needs of small and medium companies throughout the United Kingdom, Belgium, the Benelux, and most of Western Europe.

Our clients appreciate the responsiveness of our project managers, whose customer care skills, and attention to detail, are widely recognised. Our unique selling point is that at our translation agency, all of our project managers are either former or currently active translators.

Meet our experienced team, Michael, Jean-François, Suzy, Anna, Maral, and others.

Get a Quote

Fast and free quote in the UK

Receive your translation quote within a few hours

Looking for a precise, transparent, and fast translation quote for your language projects?

Why request a translation quote from a professional agency?

Translation is an important step for any UK company aiming to communicate effectively both domestically and in international markets.

A detailed translation quote allows for a precise assessment of the costs and timeframes required to complete your linguistic project, which protects your ROI from the start.

A clear quote for full budget control

Requesting a translation quote from BeTranslated gives you a clear, precise and detailed document. The quote outlines all the essential information needed to plan your project with full visibility:

  • The total project cost based on word count and language combination.
  • Guaranteed delivery deadlines to meet your milestones.
  • The specialisation of the selected translator (legal, marketing, technical, medical, etc.).
  • The delivery format of the translated documents (Word, PDF, HTML, etc.).
  • No unpleasant surprises and no hidden fees.

A customised quote for all types of projects

Whatever the language or the sector of your document, BeTranslated provides a translation quote to match your specific needs:

Commercial and marketing documents

Your quote includes the translation of brochures, advertising materials, press releases, and web content. Our network of native translators produces professional translations suited to your specific industry and target audience.

Certified and legal translation

Do you need a certified translation for contracts, notarial deeds, official documents, or certificates? Request a quote for a translation recognised by UK authorities (Home Office, NARIC) and international bodies.

Technical and scientific translations

Your technical documents in fields such as engineering, medicine, or IT require specialised experts. Your quote will specify the selected translator and the technical terminology suited to your sector.

Website localisation and multilingual SEO

A multilingual website is a powerful driver of international growth. Get a personalised quote for SEO-optimised translation in major international languages such as English, French, German, Spanish, and Chinese.

How to request your translation quote from BeTranslated?

The process is quick and simple:

  1. Send your document by email or fill in our online form.
  2. Receive a detailed response within 8 business hours.
  3. Validate your quote easily by email.
  4. Receive your professional translation within the agreed deadline.

Do you want to understand our rates before requesting your quote? Consult our page on translation rates.

Contact us today for your translation quote

Whether your company is based in London, Manchester, Birmingham, or elsewhere in the UK, the BeTranslated team provides fast and accurate responses to all enquiries.

Get your free translation quote today: transparent, professional and without obligation.

📩 Email us at global@betranslated.com 📞
